description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver implementing a Real Time Clock (RTC) for WL-HDD devices, including I2C communication, platform detection, and device registration.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Opens the RTC device, initializes I2C, and manages device state.

methods.name: rtc_release
methods.description: Releases the RTC device, updates device state.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads current RTC time and outputs in formatted string.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets RTC time based on input string in specific format.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.
